title: the best fixation target revisited: new insights from retinal eye tracking
core_idea: Reexamine how fixation-target design and polarity affect fixational eye movements (microsaccades and drift) using a high-resolution retinal eye tracker—addressing limitations of video-based trackers—by presenting five fixation targets in two polarity conditions and measuring gaze spatial spread, microsaccades, and drift.
tldr: Reassess which fixation-target designs and polarities minimize fixational eye movements using a retinal eye tracker to measure gaze spread, microsaccades, and drift across multiple targets.
